articles.title: S&P 500 added all of crypto's $2 trillion market cap in a month while bitcoin barely moved. Here's why
articles.snippet: The S&P 500 just added roughly the entire crypto market's value this month. Bitcoin has barely moved, and the reasons go beyond the obvious.

articles.title: XRP whales keep buying the dip, but ether shows deeper capitulation
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant said large XRP spot orders point to "quiet accumulation" rather than a breakout, while ether’s price below realized value leaves holders underwater and gives it the strongest valuation case among BTC, ETH and XRP.

articles.title: Ondo Finance hires former Blockchain.com CFO Adam Schlisman
articles.snippet: The tokenized-assets firm appointed ex-Blockchain.com and Monashee executive as finance chief as it expands its onchain capital markets business.

articles.title: Blockchain.com wins Cayman custody license after MiCA and FCA approvals
articles.snippet: Blockchain.com secured a VASP custody license from the Cayman Islands Monetary Authority, expanding its regulated crypto services in the region.

articles.title: SEC Bought a Billion Airline Records to Track Travelers—Likely Without a Warrant
articles.snippet: The financial regulator subscribed to a global flight database covering more than a billion tickets to monitor activity.
